integrity: Standalone proof and computational checks; finite checks do not replace analytic quantifiers; no claim of external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectral optimization and phase extrema apply only to the golden-slope constant drift on the 2π-periodic two-torus. The relaxation time of averages is proved only up to two-sided order; a precise leading coefficient is not claimed. General singular-gap texts not completely accessible remain an originality risk.
title: Fibonacci resonance and log-periodic singular-gap growth for a torus diffusion
